comparison.objective: Remember a target location after covering visual cues, then place a puck there.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handed board placement, occlusion memory, and constrained puck placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cover all indicators before moving the puck, keep them covered, and release the puck on the remembered target without forbidden contacts.
comparison.reason: This primarily tests memory under occlusion and placement constraints, not mechanical adjustment or dynamic-response commissioning. Exact pad tolerances and specs were not provided.
